desc: Packed with features and available at an unbeatable price, the Runoff deserves a spot in your pocket. The first thing you'll notice about the Runoff is its opening and closing action. Kershaw dialed in the manual KVT ball-bearing action, for extra-satisfying deployment. When put to work, the versatile clip point blade is especially efficient at piercing cuts. The dual-textured handle fills the hand comfortably for greater control, and a deep-carry pocket clip makes it convenient to travel with. The Runoff accomplishes all of this in a compact package, an easy choice for your next Kershaw.
